name: protocol_golden_m8
description: The GDScript codec decodes every message of the M8 golden transcript (the party's level, recorded from the Python server at protocol version 2: a member's PARTY difficulty answered to her alone, the leader's Hard to both with the Ready cleared, a Hard party queued beside a Normal party that would fill its seats and never merged with it, and the caretakers at 60 s: MATCH_CONFIG at difficulty 1) into the listed values, and encodes each back to the same bytes; the level sits right after the mode in PARTY_STATE and MATCH_CONFIG.

steps.msg: all 63 records decode and re-encode byte for byte
the transcript speaks this game's protocol version, 2
the parties' ops and states and the queue's three asks are in

steps.assert: report['types']['MATCH_CONFIG'] == 2 and report['types']['NOTICE'] == 2 and not report['types'].has('MATCH_FOUND')
steps.msg: no Match Found between the levels; the offer and the Hard party's config are in
PARTY difficulty round-trips by its op's name
